source.name: Texas factories that waited in texas-hubs.json for a location (its unplaced list of 36), now placed
source.licence: Facts read from public pages and records: OSHA Form 300A establishment files for 2024 and 2025 (the copies texas-hubs.json read; a headcount only where the hours come to 1,000 to 3,000 a person), the EPA registry, the state's building registrations (TDLR) and Comptroller records, company, economic development and press pages. Points from whatever places each factory best: ArcGIS World Geocoding Service address points, Williamson County's and the cities of Austin and Houston's address points, the Harris County Appraisal District's and the Cass Appraisal District's parcels (the latter through TxGIO's StratMap land parcels), and Esri World Imagery read by hand; each plant's coordinatesFrom says which. Every plant cites its sources; every headcount its own.

plants.name: EVS Texas Pflugerville
plants.products: Precision sheet metal parts and CNC-machined components (laser cutting, punching, forming, welding, powder coating)
plants.employeesNote: OSHA Form 300A, 2025: 'EVS TEXAS INC' (EVS TX, INC), 400 S. Heatherwild Blvd, Pflugerville: 100 annual average employees (188,315 hours, about 1,880 a person). The filing gives the operation's earlier address; its Texas production has moved to 15508 Impact Way.
plants.coordinatesFrom: ArcGIS World Geocoding Service findAddressCandidates, PointAddress (score 100) '15508 Impact Way, Pflugerville, Texas, 78660' (https://geocode.arcgis.com/arcgis/rest/services/World/GeocodeServer); EPA construction-permit points for the EVS site (110071658098, 110071959567) lie about 110 m and 140 m away
plants.note: Company page: 'EVS Metal's Pflugerville, Texas facility is the newest in the EVS network — a 139,000 square foot production center rebuilt from the ground up in 2026', at 15508 Impact Way, Suite 100, running laser cutting, CNC punching, forming, welding, hardware insertion, powder coating and multi-axis machining; ITAR registered. PCDC release (7 Mar 2024): groundbreaking in One Thirty Business Park for a 175,000 sq ft facility; the company, at 400 S. Heatherwilde since 2001, 'will relocate and expand its operations'. TDLR TABS2022023681: EVS Metal Fabrication shell building, south end of Impact Way, 162,284 sq ft (closed, due 30 Jun 2025); TABS2024021777: finish-out of Building One, Suite 100, for a new manufacturing operation.
